title: Shoals Fly Fishing and Light Tackle
specs: Fishing in prime Seacoast area of Little Harbor adjacent to Atlantic Ocean and inland rivers
World class Striped Bass fishery with large migratory schools from late May to June
Bluefish present late June to end of September with large schools feeding on Peanut Bunker
Schoolie Bluefin Tuna averaging 30-50 lbs with some over 100 lbs in recent years
Captain is USCG Captain and Registered Maine Tidewater Guide
Miss Jodine has New Hampshire charter boat permit and NMFS Permit
Accommodates up to 4 anglers; contact captain for larger parties

blurb: Guests fish for Striped Bass, Bluefish, and Tuna using fly or light spinning gear in New Hampshire and Maine waters. The vessel Miss Jodine is berthed at Wentworth By the Sea Marina in Newcastle, NH, close to prime fishing areas. The fishing season runs from late May to mid-October for Striped Bass and mid to late July through September for Tuna.
